text:
alex.k: Heads-up — a bunch of GPU batch jobs in eu-west are seeing gRPC stream stalls when importing model shards. Pods hang mid-stream for ~3-6s then resume.

danielle: seen it on canary too, noticed throughput drop on dedicated pools. Any packet drops? :thinking_face:

akshay: grabbed tcpdump on node pair. lots of fragmented packets and retransmits between node-12 and node-21. looks like large UDP/TCP frames are being chopped.

alex.k: here's the quick `ip link` diff I pulled from the two nodes:

```
# node-12 (worker with GPUs)
2: eth0: mtu 9000 qdisc mq state UP mode DEFAULT group default qlen 1000
    link/ether 0a:58:... brd ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff

# node-21 (egress toward other AZ)
2: eth0: mtu 8950 qdisc mq state UP mode DEFAULT group default qlen 1000
    link/ether 0a:67:... brd ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff
```

akshay: that 50-byte skew matches VXLAN/GENEVE overhead in our overlay + ENA offload math. packets get fragmented on one hop and reassembly fails for the gRPC streaming window.

mira: this fits the RoCE/ENA reports — when GSO/TSO is on, ENA hands giant segs to HW, but the VXLAN tunnel reduces path-MTU. kernel doesn't always generate ICMP PMTU because of offload, so app-level streams stall.

danielle: so which side should we clamp? kube-cni mtu or node NIC?

akshay: short-term mitigation: disable GSO on the vxlan interface or set node sysctl `net.ipv4.tcp_mtu_probing=1` and patch CNI to use mtu=8950 for affected AZs. Both are ops-friendly.

mira: patch proposal: rollout a DaemonSet to `ip link set dev vxlan0 mtu 8950` and a small kube-cni config change for the eu-west region. test on canary before mass rollout.

alex.k: impact on GPU jobs? will throughput drop?

akshay: small percent hit (~2-4%) on max throughput due to smaller jumbo frames, but it eliminates 3-6s stall spikes that cause RPC retries and job fragmentation — overall latency/cost wins.

danielle: ok please schedule canary today. timeline?

mira: I can push the DaemonSet within the hour to canary nodes (node-21 group). netbot, create incident stub for tracking and link PRs.

netbot: Incident created: INC-2026-4489 (MTU asymmetry -> gRPC stream stalls). Assigned: eng-infra, priority P2.

alex.k: thanks. post results here after canary. if green, we do a rolling patch to eu-west and update CNI template.

akshay: one more note — if anyone sees RDMA-enabled nodes, double-check RoCE config; those hit blackhole behavior earlier. For now exclude RDMA nodes from the DaemonSet until we confirm RoCE path-MTU.

mira: will do. cc @oncall for overnight monitoring. :thumbsup:
